the_full_pre_registered_experiment.authority: Article XXXVI — Experiment Validity Gate. All 7 conditions must pass.

condition_1_PRE_REGISTRATION_VALID.status: This file IS the pre-registration. It will be hash-pinned after commit.

condition_2_IMPLEMENTATION_MATCHES_PROTO.requirement: The experiment script must implement EXACTLY what this pre-registration specifies. No substitution, no simplification.
condition_2_IMPLEMENTATION_MATCHES_PROTO.the_experiment: Biofouling temporal lead simulation with 300 patients, 365-day horizon, 4 detection thresholds (5%, 10%, 15%, 20%), 3 baselines (ICP, flow, no monitoring), and primary endpoint = median incremental lead days.

baselines.baseline_A_ICP: ICP detection at 20 mmHg (clinical concern threshold). This is the standard clinical threshold used in practice.
baselines.baseline_B_flow: Flow detection at 50% reduction from baseline. This represents the best available non-invasive flow monitoring.
baselines.baseline_C_none: No monitoring — failure detected only at symptoms (ICP > 25 mmHg). This is the negative control.
baselines.candidate_H1_biofouling: Biofouling sensor detection at 5%, 10%, 15%, 20% coverage thresholds.

condition_3_BASELINE_FAIR.fairness_rule: All baselines use the same patient cohort, same fouling model, same failure definition. No baseline is artificially weakened.

condition_4_NO_DATA_LEAKAGE.rule: The biofouling sensor does NOT have access to ICP or flow data. It measures a DIFFERENT physical quantity (surface deposition). The signals are causally linked but not informationally shared.

condition_5_THRESHOLDS_FROZEN.win_threshold: median incremental lead > 7 days at the best threshold
condition_5_THRESHOLDS_FROZEN.kill_threshold: median incremental lead < 2 days at ALL thresholds

provenance.7_days: CLINICAL — 7 days allows scheduled elective surgery instead of emergent presentation. Derived from neurosurgical scheduling practice.
provenance.2_days: CLINICAL — less than 2 days is operationally indistinguishable from same-day detection. No actionable lead time.

condition_7_RANDOM_SEED_COHORT_PROVENANC.cohort_generation: np.random.RandomState(42), patient parameters drawn from uniform distributions as specified above
condition_7_RANDOM_SEED_COHORT_PROVENANC.single_run: Only ONE run per pre-registration. No multiple-seed averaging.

primary_endpoint.definition: Median across patients of (biofouling_detection_lead - best_existing_signal_lead), where best_existing = max(ICP_lead, flow_lead)
primary_endpoint.reported_per_threshold: Yes — report for each of 4 thresholds

secondary_endpoints: percentage of patients with incremental lead > 7 days
percentage of patients with incremental lead > 30 days

decision_rule.WIN: median incremental lead > 7 days at ANY threshold AND physical moat CONFIRMED
decision_rule.KILL: median incremental lead < 2 days at ALL thresholds

the_sensor_design_question.the_open_question: What sensor modality can measure biofouling deposition on a shunt catheter at 5% coverage?
candidate_modalities: Impedance spectroscopy — measures changes in electrical impedance as protein/cells deposit on the catheter surface. Sensitive to surface coverage.
Optical coherence tomography (OCT) — uses light to image the catheter surface at micron resolution. Can detect thin biofilms.
Ultrasound backscatter — measures acoustic reflection from the catheter surface. Changes with surface roughness/deposition.
Quartz crystal microbalance (QCM) — measures mass deposition on a resonant crystal. Extremely sensitive but may not integrate into a shunt.
the_sensor_design_question.feasibility: ALL four modalities are established technologies in other contexts. The engineering question is: can they be miniaturized and integrated into a shunt catheter? This is a Level 7 (physical validation) question.
